df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# per-group: compare avg 10-20..10-22 vs 10-10..10-19

    anom = s[s.date>='2025-10-20']['unblended_cost'].mean()
    pb = s[s.date<'2025-10-20']['price'].mean(); pa = s[s.date>='2025-10-20']['price'].mean()
    nb = s[s.date<'2025-10-20']['num_instances'].mean(); na = s[s.date>='2025-10-20']['num_instances'].mean()
    rows.append((k, base, anom, anom-base, pb, pa, nb, na))
r = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['key','base','anom','delta','p_before','p_after','n_before','n_after'])
print(r.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(10).to_string())
print("total delta:", r['delta'].sum())

r = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['key','p_b','p_a','n_b','n_a','n_bmax','n_amin','nstd','price_change','inst_jump'])

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()

# z-score vs prior baseline for each group on 10-20, and check price/instance drivers
res=[]
for k,s in a.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']):
    b = s[s.date < '2025-10-20']; ab = s[s.date >= '2025-10-20']
    mu, sd = b.unblended_cost.mean(), b.unblended_cost.std()
    zc = (ab.unblended_cost.mean()-mu)/sd if sd and sd>0 else float('inf') if ab.unblended_cost.mean()>mu else 0
    zb = (b.price.mean()-b.price.mean())/1
    # instance count anomaly: compare 10-20 count to prior max+3std
    n_mu, n_sd = b.num_instances.mean(), b.num_instances.std()
    p_mu, p_sd = b.price.mean(), b.price.std()
    n_z = (ab.num_instances.mean()-n_mu)/n_sd if n_sd and n_sd>0 else (float('inf') if ab.num_instances.mean()!=n_mu else 0)
    p_z = (ab.price.mean()-p_mu)/p_sd if p_sd and p_sd>0 else (float('inf') if ab.price.mean()!=p_mu else 0)
    res.append((k, zc, n_z, p_z, ab.unblended_cost.mean()-mu))
r = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['key','cost_z','n_z','p_z','delta']).sort_values('delta', ascending=False)
print(r.head(8).to_string())

    zb = (b.price.mean()-b.price.mean())/1
    # instance count anomaly: compare 10-20 count to prior max+3std

    n_z = (ab.num_instances.mean()-n_mu)/n_sd if n_sd and n_sd>0 else (float('inf') if ab.num_instances.mean()!=n_mu else 0)
    p_z = (ab.price.mean()-p_mu)/p_sd if p_sd and p_sd>0 else (float('inf') if ab.price.mean()!=p_mu else 0)
    res.append((k, zc, n_z, p_z, ab.unblended_cost.mean()-mu))
